answer: Tie every new agent identity to a non-refundable bond, and let a public randomness beacon assign which peers audit it so an attacker cannot pick friendly graders. When heuristics flag identities whose behavior moves in lockstep, their required collateral spirals super-linearly: a thousand sybils then cost far more than a thousand honest agents. Legitimate nodes instead grow a willow-like mesh of cross-attestations that no single actor can forge cheaply.
